reviews.title: Inconsistent and poor service
reviews.text:
After having this app for a couple years, I found it nice and easy to use, I even upgraded to a paid plan. However I recently decided to end my subscription and delete the app after several poor experiences:

- Cloud Vault space saver: suddenly stopped saving space. The same amount of data was being used both on and off my device, defeating the purpose of space saver 
- when asked why to customer service, they ask to send a diagnostic. I sent this in twice and stopped hearing back. Attempts to chase the email thread resulted in further silence. 
- I entirely deleted the contents of my cloud vault and tried to set it up again from scratch, and the same result occurred

Why would I pay for an app that doesn’t provide the service it previously provided and no fixes provided from support staff.

reviews.title: Annoying and expensive
reviews.text: When transferring photos from my Apple photos into photo vault, the photos go into the ‘main album’. Unfortunately, they end up completely out of order. They are not in date order, just all over the place. Its even worse if there are photos already in the main album, any new photos just get jumbled up with them. It’s then a big headache to go through and put them in any sort of order. They are just randomly scattered in the folder. Also, I have noticed that the app briefly flashes the last image viewed prior to the log-in screen. The subscription fees I feel are much too high for what you get. Unfortunately, there doesn’t seem to be many good alternatives to this app yet.

reviews.title: “Improvements”
reviews.text:
These “improvements” have made this app sluggishly slow to open, any ‘secure’ folders are just as slow to request password/touch-id, and the “improved” icons for secure folders look like icons from 30 years ago. What happened to the good “Photo Vault” icons from the previous version?
I have sadly decided this app has been “improved”  to the state that I am going to look for another faster, better looking and secure photo app and delete this one.
PS. Despite my settings on my ipad preventing apps requesting feedback, the first thing this app did after the update was ask if I liked the app. This further annoyed me.
Goodbye!                                                                                  PPS. It seems the latest “improvement” has started to bombard people with Ads for ‘Premium’, Ads for ‘Sale’, and claims that my subscription for Premium has expired and I need to renew ASAP! I am now definitely going to look for another secure App, and deleting this one!                                                                                                 I don’t like being nagged every time I open an App.

reviews.title: Not as secure as you think.
reviews.text: This is just a password protected photo viewer. It does not encrypt your photos ON your device. Don’t expect the trash folder to be encrypted either. You can test this by comparing it to Vaultair which takes 2-3 seconds to open because it is decrypting your vault on your device. Pic Safe is instant. So, if you use password/face recognition on your iOS device you get just what Apple Photos gives without paying extra. Also iCloud encrypts your data when it is in iCloud, so, if the app is not encrypted, I do not see the point. It turns out nearly every so-called photo vault on iOS is the same. However, saying that, it has its good points. I like the albums, the way you can slide them snd photos around in any order, the easy import and export and the photo editing and that you can add text which is very good. Bottom line, as an image viewer its great, secure? No more than your iPad itself.
